radroach.name: Radroach
radroach.description: A giant mutated cockroach, the size of a dog.

mongrel.name: Wild Mongrel
mongrel.description: A feral dog, stripped of its fur by radiation.

raider.name: Raider
raider.description: A hostile wasteland scavenger looking for trouble.

raider_scum.name: Raider Scum
raider_scum.description: A weak raider with makeshift armor.

feral_ghoul.name: Feral Ghoul
feral_ghoul.description: A mindless, irradiated human common in the tunnels and abandoned buildings of Berlin.

super_mutant.name: Super Mutant
super_mutant.description: A hulking green humanoid with immense strength.

super_mutant_warlord.name: Super Mutant Warlord
super_mutant_warlord.description: A massive, scarred Super Mutant commanding respect and fear.

sniper.name: Iron Ring Sniper
sniper.description: A deadly marksman watching from the shadows.

rad_wolf.name: Radhund
rad_wolf.description: A mutated German Shepherd, highly loyal to its pack. Found in packs across the surface streets and particularly in Grunewald.

spree_swan_charm.name: Spreeschwan
spree_swan_charm.description: A mutated swan with a 2-meter wingspan, irrationally aggressive and possessing a radioactive bite. Can swim and fly.

vault_admin.name: Vault Administrator
vault_admin.description: Armed with Stun Batons and bureaucratic arrogance.

the_janitor.name: The Janitor
the_janitor.description: A legendary Protectron in Vault U7 that treats 'intruders' as 'unauthorized waste'.

super_mutant_master.name: Super Mutant Master
super_mutant_master.description: A seasoned Super Mutant commanding a small squad.

centaur.name: Centaur
centaur.description: A horrific amalgamation of human and animal parts.

yao_guai.name: Berliner Bär
yao_guai.description: A formidable, mutated bear, often 4m tall when standing, with striking gold-colored fur. Highly territorial and aggressive.

deathclaw_runt.name: Deathclaw Runt
deathclaw_runt.description: A smaller, but still deadly, Deathclaw.

dealer_ghoul.name: Dealer Ghoul
dealer_ghoul.description: A ghoul that seems to have been a drug dealer in a past life.

feral_ghoul_reaver.name: Feral Ghoul Reaver
feral_ghoul_reaver.description: A heavily armored and incredibly resilient feral ghoul.

bundesritter_knight.name: Bundesritter Knight
bundesritter_knight.description: A highly disciplined knight in custom power armor, wielding energy weapons.

feld_commune_guard.name: Feld Commune Guard
feld_commune_guard.description: A loyal and fanatical guard of the Feld Commune, equipped with improvised weapons.

doner_mafia_thug.name: Döner Mafia Thug
doner_mafia_thug.description: A territorial thug working for the Döner Mafia, armed with knives and a bad attitude.

landlord_ghoul.name: Landlord Ghoul
landlord_ghoul.description: A ghoul gang member from the Neukölln Catacombs, obsessed with collecting 'rent'.

wall_breaker.name: Wall Breaker
wall_breaker.description: A chaotic raider from Wedding, skilled with explosives and focused on destruction.

wall_breaker_raider.name: Wall Breaker Raider
wall_breaker_raider.description: A chaotic raider from Wedding, skilled with explosives.

iron_ring_patrol.name: Iron Ring Patrol
iron_ring_patrol.description: A standard patrol unit of the Iron Ring.

spreekreb.name: Spreekreb
spreekreb.description: A giant mutated crab from the Spree river.

iron_ring_soldier.name: Iron Ring Soldier
iron_ring_soldier.description: A heavily armored soldier of the Iron Ring.

iron_ring_officer.name: Iron Ring Officer
iron_ring_officer.description: An officer of the Iron Ring, commanding respect.

baumgeist.name: Baumgeist
baumgeist.description: A dryad-like mutant camouflaged as a tree.

automated_defense_turret.name: Defense Turret
automated_defense_turret.description: An automated turret defending the vault.

ghoul_merchant.name: Ghoul Merchant
ghoul_merchant.description: A trader who has seen better days (and centuries).
